metadata.description: Small quality-of-life mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: folder-title
plugins.description: Prefixes every session title with its project folder: "<folder> - <title>"

plugins.name: reload-inventory
plugins.description: Lists plugins and skills with versions after /reload-plugins and /reload-skills

plugins.name: drop-relay
plugins.description: Shows why a hook blocked a prompt on every device, Remote Control included, as a transcript notice

plugins.name: session-launcher
plugins.description: /fs [folder] starts a fresh Remote Control session in auto mode, in this folder or another, from any device
